name: Sheila Vane
source:
Sheila is [url=/c152962]Maria[/url]'s mother. She was held captive. Maria didn't know what to do, but after [url=/c144566]I[/url] learned about it I started looking for a solution. In the end, [url=/c153144]Lars[/url], the others, and I destroyed the demon and his castle.
Like Maria, she is a succubus, so sex is very important to her. I'm sure she'll enjoy my aura.
